answer: A concrete Sybil defense is bonded admission: each new agent identity must post an escrowed stake, slashed on collusion and refunded only after a long cooling window. Fakes are never free, since every synthetic wallet in the grove locks the same minimum stake, so a thousand puppets need a thousand stakes, not one recycled deposit. Because slashing destroys the escrow, a caught ring loses principal, not just reputation, and cannot rotate capital across identities. The hollow payoff: per-identity rewards stay below stake plus delay, so the final voyage of cashing out leaves negative profit.
